title: Tissue Cyclic Immunofluorescence (t-CyCIF)
author: Jia Ren Lin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bjiukkew
materials: Cover the tissue with secondary antibodies and incubate in the dark at Room temperature for 02:00:00 .

steps.title: Initial Fluorophore Bleaching
steps.instruction: Bleach the tissue to reduce autofluorescence and inactivate secondary antibody fluorophores from pre-staining.

substeps.instruction: Place slides flat in a plastic transparent container, tissue facing up.
Gently pour fluorophore bleaching solution to completely cover the tissue.
Place the container between two LED light panels (one above and one below) at Room temperature for 00:45:00.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Block Non-Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with the secondary antibody solution used in the pre-staining procedure in the dark at 4 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Place slides in the slide tray and cover all tissues with the solution.
Place damp paper towels in the tray to maintain humidity and prevent evaporation.
Avoid using a hydrophobic barrier pen and be careful not to scratch tissue with pipette tips.

steps.title: Secondary Bleaching
steps.instruction: Bleach the fluorophores for 00:30:00 at Room temperature as described in the initial bleaching step.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash to completely remove bleaching solution.

steps.title: Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with Hoechst solution (2.5 µg/ml) in the dark at Room temperature for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Mount Coverslips
steps.instruction: Mount coverslips onto slides using 200 µL of 10% (vol:vol) glycerol in 1X PBS to prevent dehydration.

substeps.instruction: Position coverslips over the center of each slide and lower slowly to avoid bubbles and scratching.
Ensure coverslips do not overhang the edge of the slide.
Dry excess liquid by gently pressing the long edges of the slide against a paper towel.

steps.title: Background Imaging
steps.instruction: Load the slide into the RareCyte CyteFinder and image at each wavelength to record the background signal.

substeps.instruction: Scan only the region covered in tissue and save this region of interest (ROI) for subsequent rounds.
Adjust exposure times to remain in a linear range.

steps.title: Remove Coverslips
steps.instruction: Remove coverslips by placing slides in 1X PBS in a staining dish (holding slides vertically) for 00:10:00.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pull slides vertically out of the solution, allowing the coverslip to fall away by gravity.

steps.title: Wash and Store
steps.instruction: Wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Store slides in 1X PBS at 4 °C for several days, ensuring tissue remains covered.

steps.title: First Round Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue with up to three unconjugated primary antibodies from different species (e.g., rabbit, mouse, rat) in Intercept® (PBS) Blocking Buffer in the dark at 4 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Dilute antibodies to appropriate concentrations (typically starting at 1:100) based on manufacturer recommendations and empirical testing.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with Hoechst solution (2.5 µg/ml) in the dark at Room temperature for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Mount and Image ROI
steps.instruction: Mount coverslips with 200 µL of 10% glycerol in PBS and image the saved ROI with the RareCyte CyteFinder.

steps.title: Remove Coverslips and Wash
steps.instruction: Remove coverslips as previously described and wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Fluorophore Bleaching
steps.instruction: Perform fluorophore bleaching for 00:45:00 at Room temperature as described in the first step.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash to remove all bleaching solution.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Store slides in 1X PBS at 4 °C for several days.

steps.title: Subsequent Cycle Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute up to three conjugated antibodies (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488, 555, 647) in Intercept® (PBS) Blocking Buffer and incubate in the dark at 4 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Avoid using Alexa Fluor 546, 568, and 594 as they are difficult to bleach.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate with Hoechst solution (2.5 µg/ml) in the dark at Room temperature for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Mount and Image ROI
steps.instruction: Mount coverslips onto slides with 200 µL of 10% (vol:vol) glycerol in PBS and image the saved ROI with the RareCyte CyteFinder.

steps.title: Remove Coverslips
steps.instruction: Remove the coverslips as previously described.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Fluorophore Bleaching
steps.instruction: Bleach the fluorophores for 00:45:00 at Room temperature as described.

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides 4 times with 1X PBS at Room temperature for 00:03:00 (max 5 min) per wash.

steps.title: Repeat Cycles
steps.instruction: Repeat the cycle starting from the conjugated antibody incubation step for each additional round.

description: Pre-staining and Background Determination takes approximately 16-24 hours. Make fluorophore bleaching solution. Combine 25 mL 1X PBS, 4.5 mL 30% (wt/vol) H 2 O 2 , and 0.8 mL 1 Molarity (M) NaOH in a 50-ml centrifuge tube. The final working concentration is 4.5% (wt/vol) H 2 O 2 and 20 millimolar (mM) NaOH in PBS. 30 mL fluorophore bleaching solution is enough for four standard slides. CRITICAL STEP Fluorophore bleaching solution should be prepared immediately before use.
